items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Later on, I made an album in which we repeated some of the things I did and it was the first time he had ever accompanied a singer.

ctx.x: With Dick Hyman (unintelligible) on your Shakespeare album.
Right. You know, there's been a lot of renditions of 'Lover, Come Back, Come Home.' But Dick had evidently heard some of the things -- and I didn't even know Dick at that time.
But he liked the idea. Later on, I made an album in which we repeated some of the things I did and it was the first time he had ever accompanied a singer.
